use_case_summary: Rivermark needs a federated research search: embeddings-based retrieval over 50M+ docs with GPU-assisted reranking for top-K results, integrated into analyst portal with citation tracing and ephemeral context caching. Must preserve residency and keys via customer-managed KMS.
indexing_scale: Initial POC: 50M documents (≈3.2B tokens), expected production: 150-200M docs over 18 months; estimated embeddings storage ~5TB compressed.
latency_targets: Search tail (p95) target <200ms for retrieval step, end-to-end (retrieve + rerank) p95 <600ms; desire sub-300ms for analyst UX on hot sets.
cost_target_per_query: Target unit cost: <$0.01 per query (embeddings + lightweight rerank). Will accept higher cost during POC but requires optimization plan (batching, cache, quantization).
model_preferences: Prefer open/transparent embeddings (SBERT-like) and a small distilled reranker that can be pinned and quantized. Fallback routing to cheaper dense-only variant when dedicated pool is saturated.
poc_results: Indexed 5M sample: retrieval recall ~0.83 for analyst queries (bench dataset).
Reranker improved top-5 MRR by +12% but doubled GPU latency on naive setup.
